The Pro League action continued on April 30, 2026 , as Al Akhdoud hosted Al Ettifaq in a contest defined by tactical discipline and sudden shifts in momentum. With both teams desperate for points to climb the table, the stage was set for an intriguing encounter where individual moments of brilliance would likely determine the outcome. Medran Breaks the Deadlock The match began with a cautious feeling-out process as both squads tested each other's defensive structures. The first significant incident occurred in the 22nd minute when the referee reached for his pocket, issuing a yellow card to Francisco Calvo following a cynical challenge that broke up a promising move. For much of the opening period, clear-cut chances were at a premium as the midfield battle took center stage, but the atmosphere remained electric as the half-way point approached. Just as the first half appeared to be heading toward a goalless stalemate, the deadlock was finally broken in stoppage time. In the 46th minute ( 45+1' ), Alvaro Medran found a pocket of space and rifled a shot home to give Al Ettifaq the lead. It was a hammer blow for the hosts, who had defended stoutly until that point, but the goal injected a much-needed sense of urgency into the proceedings heading into the interval. Al Akhdoud Fight Back The second half ignited immediately with Mohau Nkota receiving a caution in the 47th minute, signaling a more aggressive approach from Al Akhdoud as they sought a way back into the game. Their persistence and high press eventually paid off at the hour mark. Following a well-worked attacking sequence down the flank, Khaled Narey delivered a precise pass into the box for Juan Pedroza , who finished clinically to restore parity. The equalizer sent the home fans into a frenzy and briefly shifted the momentum in favor of the hosts. Recognizing the shift in power, Al Ettifaq manager reacted quickly by introducing Mukhtar Sheik for Ondrej Duda to shore up the midfield. The game became a more open affair after the goal, with both sides trading blows and searching for a decisive third goal. Al Akhdoud also looked to their bench shortly after, bringing on Khaled Al-Lazam to maintain their offensive pressure as the match entered its final twenty minutes. The Wijnaldum Impact As the clock ticked toward the final stages, Al Ettifaq rediscovered their clinical edge. In the 74th minute, Khalid Al Ghannam stepped up to restore the visitors' advantage, capitalizing on a defensive lapse to make it 2-1. Not content with just a single-goal cushion, Al Ghannam turned provider only six minutes later. He orchestrated a brilliant move that allowed the experienced Georginio Wijnaldum to find the back of the net in the 80th minute, effectively putting the game out of reach. In a desperate bid to claw back into the game, Al Akhdoud made a quadruple substitution in the 84th minute, introducing fresh legs including Mohammed Juhaif and Saleh Al-Harthi . However, Al Ettifaq 's defensive discipline held firm against the late barrage. With seven minutes of stoppage time added, the visitors managed the game expertly, eventually celebrating a hard-fought victory when the final whistle blew to conclude a dramatic evening of football .
